button.classes: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all duration-200 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-amber-400 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 active:scale-95
